title: Input across display generations regression (O14InputContractRelaunchTest)
test_commit: f9e50a4 (pre-commit; test file added in this commit's child)

commands.run_test: adb -s emulator-5556 shell am instrument -w -e class com.pocketrealm.o14.O14InputContractRelaunchTest com.pocketrealm.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner

generation_N.note: Keyboard A, absolute pointer move + left-click observed through the Win32 probe (session-scoped stdout). Held W key + right-button, then releaseAll(ON_PAUSE) released both deterministically before the client closed.

generation_N+1.probe_ok_line: POCKET_SELFTEST_OK audio_attempted=0 audio_ok=0 keys_seen=1 right_seen=0 middle_seen=0 wheel_seen=0 relmove_seen=0
generation_N+1.note: Fresh ClientDisplayHost/InputContract generation. Keyboard A, absolute pointer move + left-click observed through the Win32 probe (separate session, independent stdout from generation N). The stale generation-N right-button event was rejected and did NOT reach the probe (right_seen=0).

stale_event_rejection.evidence: genN1 rightButtonSeen=false and probe right_seen=0 confirm the stale event was rejected by the contract before reaching the X server or Win32 probe.

final_state.note: releaseAll(CLOSE) on generation N+1 reported 0 keys + 0 buttons. No stale Pocket Realm client process remains.

test_integrity.not_faked_by_integer_change: Each generation constructs a new ClientDisplayHost (new InputContract, new generation counter value) and launches a separate Wine process (separate sessionId, separate captured stdout).
test_integrity.input_success_not_inferred_from_dispatch: All input observations come from the Win32 probe stdout (POCKET_SELFTEST_KEY, POCKET_SELFTEST_MOUSE), not from dispatchKey/dispatchPointer return values.
test_integrity.probe_output_separated_by_generation: Each runtime.launch() creates a new SessionRecord with its own stdout; collectDiagnostics(sessionId) returns only that session's stdout. Generation-N observations come from a different sessionId than generation-N+1.
test_integrity.pre_run_and_per_generation_probe_logs_pr: The genN1 stdoutTail in the evidence shows the final probe OK line with right_seen=0, confirming the stale event did not reach it.

remaining_gaps: O14 remains pending: IME, gamepad, pointer capture, profile persistence, touch overlay not implemented.
UX-T01 through UX-T08 are NOT complete.
Increment-1 verification is now complete (single-generation input + stale rejection + multi-generation input across host replacement).
